# Narrative-Performance Gap Template

| Narrative claim | Evidence source | Action alignment | Contradiction risk | Stakeholder signal | Revision required |
|---|---|---:|---:|---:|---|
| [Claim] | [Evidence] | [0-1] | [0-1] | [0-1] | [Yes/No] |

## Review questions

- Do budgets match the narrative?
- Do metrics match the narrative?
- Do decisions match the narrative?
- Do stakeholder experiences confirm or contradict the narrative?
- What evidence would require the story to change?
